_: scripts/comment-strippers.mjs — per file, how many comment-stripping sites (regex / scanner / parser / filter) REMAIN under tests/ and scripts/. scripts/code-only.mjs.why: This IS the canonical reader — the scanner every other file imports (lang / offsets / literals options) and the acorn onComment path behind parser:'acorn'. Every other site in tests/ and scripts/ is routed here.

tests/r345-checks.test.mjs.why: LEGACY is the regex-pair heuristic kept as a SPECIMEN: test 8 feeds it the fixtures it truncates ('not // a comment', a template with // inside) and the ones where it deletes a whole call, and asserts the shared reader does not. A proof that the old form is wrong needs the old form.

tests/stalled-fetch-and-surface-gauge-ch.why: replacedCodeOnly is the character loop global-surface used before it tokenized with the parser, kept verbatim as the MUTANT: the regex-literal fixture must be red on it and green on the shared reader, or the test proves nothing.
